podcast.body: The booklet for *Black Gives Way to Blue*, the first Alice in Chains album featuring new singer William DuVall, includes a photo of Mariah O'Brien holding her heart. "And that's her holding her heart inside the booklet of Black Gives Way to Blue, the first Ellison Chains album with new singer William DuVall."

podcast.title: Comeback Album
podcast.body: Released on September 29, 2009, this album marked the band's return after nearly 14 years since their last record, featuring William DuVall on lead vocals. It achieved gold status in both the US and Canada. "And so on September 29th, 2009, a few weeks short of 14 years since the last Allison Chains album, came a record entitled Black Gives Way to Blue."
